name: Raen
desc:
Raen is a Adret NPC. He is a Knife of Eylis residing within the [Voidheart](location:voidheart).

He gives a few pointers to new Voidwalkers on what to do for progression.

If the player chooses the dialogue option "I see. Can you help me with affording equipment?" a new dialogue choice will appear for [Rook Rethige](entity:rook_rethige).
